description:
The process starts with defining the objectives of a marketing campaign, including the target audience and goals such as generating leads or increasing brand awareness.
The marketing team creates the content, designs the visuals, and selects channels for promotion, whether digital ads, emails, or social media posts.
The campaign is launched, and its performance is tracked in real-time through various metrics like click-through rates and conversions.
Leads generated from the campaign are collected in the CRM system, where sales teams can follow up.
The process concludes when the campaign period ends, and performance is analyzed for future optimization.
generated_bpmn_xml:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL"
                  targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/marketing-campaign">
  <bpmn:process id="Process_MarketingCampaign" name="Marketing campaign" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_Campaign" name="Campaign process starts">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Start_DefineObjectives</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:startEvent>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_DefineObjectives" name="Define campaign objectives, target audience, and goals">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Start_DefineObjectives</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_DefineObjectives_CreateContent</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CreateContent" name="Create campaign content">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_DefineObjectives_CreateContent</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_CreateContent_DesignVisuals</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_DesignVisuals" name="Design campaign visuals">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_CreateContent_DesignVisuals</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_DesignVisuals_SelectChannels</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_SelectChannels" name="Select promotion channels">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_DesignVisuals_SelectChannels</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_SelectChannels_Launch</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_LaunchCampaign" name="Launch campaign">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_SelectChannels_Launch</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Launch_ParallelSplit</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_Campaign_Split" name="Run campaign activities">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Launch_ParallelSplit</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Split_TrackPerformance</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Split_CampaignPeriod</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Split_CollectLeads</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:parallelGateway>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_TrackPerformance" name="Track performance in real time, including click-through rates and conversions">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Split_TrackPerformance</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_TrackPerformance_Join</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_CampaignPeriodEnds" name="Campaign period ends">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Split_CampaignPeriod</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_CampaignPeriod_Join</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:timerEventDefinition id="TimerDefinition_CampaignPeriodEnds"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_TrackingPeriod_Join" name="Tracking and campaign period complete">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_TrackPerformance_Join</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_CampaignPeriod_Join</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Join_AnalyzePerformance</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:parallelGateway>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_AnalyzePerformance" name="Analyze performance for future optimization">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Join_AnalyzePerformance</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Analyze_End</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_PerformanceAnalyzed" name="Campaign performance analyzed">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Analyze_End</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_CollectLeads" name="Collect generated leads in the CRM system">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Split_CollectLeads</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_CollectLeads_FollowUp</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_SalesFollowUp" name="Follow up with leads">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_CollectLeads_FollowUp</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_FollowUp_End</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_LeadFollowUp" name="Lead follow-up completed">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_FollowUp_End</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Start_DefineObjectives" sourceRef="StartEvent_Campaign" targetRef="Task_DefineObjectives"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_DefineObjectives_CreateContent" sourceRef="Task_DefineObjectives" targetRef="Task_CreateContent"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CreateContent_DesignVisuals" sourceRef="Task_CreateContent" targetRef="Task_DesignVisuals"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_DesignVisuals_SelectChannels" sourceRef="Task_DesignVisuals" targetRef="Task_SelectChannels"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SelectChannels_Launch" sourceRef="Task_SelectChannels" targetRef="Task_LaunchCampaign"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Launch_ParallelSplit" sourceRef="Task_LaunchCampaign" targetRef="Gateway_Campaign_Split"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Split_TrackPerformance" sourceRef="Gateway_Campaign_Split" targetRef="Task_TrackPerformance"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Split_CampaignPeriod" sourceRef="Gateway_Campaign_Split" targetRef="Event_CampaignPeriodEnds"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Split_CollectLeads" sourceRef="Gateway_Campaign_Split" targetRef="Task_CollectLeads"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_TrackPerformance_Join" sourceRef="Task_TrackPerformance" targetRef="Gateway_TrackingPeriod_Join"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CampaignPeriod_Join" sourceRef="Event_CampaignPeriodEnds" targetRef="Gateway_TrackingPeriod_Join"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Join_AnalyzePerformance" sourceRef="Gateway_TrackingPeriod_Join" targetRef="Task_AnalyzePerformance"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Analyze_End" sourceRef="Task_AnalyzePerformance" targetRef="EndEvent_PerformanceAnalyzed"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CollectLeads_FollowUp" sourceRef="Task_CollectLeads" targetRef="Task_SalesFollowUp"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_FollowUp_End" sourceRef="Task_SalesFollowUp" targetRef="EndEvent_LeadFollowUp"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
